name.en: Build a facility in town (you fund it)
name.ja: 街に施設を建てる（出資する）

description.en: Adds an investment desk to the administrative office. Choose a kind of facility (inn, shop, smithy, specialty shop, training hall or arena) and a grade; the building appears in one of the town wards with a keeper of its own. Inside, the game's own trade, training, lodging and matches work as usual. How many you can build in one settlement depends on its size (1 in a village, 2 in a town, 3 in a city), and both the cost and the takings scale with it. Visit the building to collect what it has earned since your last visit
description.ja: 役場に出資の窓口を足す。施設の種類（宿屋・雑貨店・鍛冶屋・専門店・道場・闘技場）と等級を選ぶと、その街の区画の1つに建物が建ち、主人が1人立つ。中ではゲーム自身の売買・訓練・宿泊・試合がそのまま動く。1つの街に建てられる軒数は規模で決まり（村1・町2・都市3）、費用も売上も規模に応じて増える。建物を訪ねると、前回からの売上を受け取れる

note.ja: 種類ごとの基礎額 × 等級 × 街の規模 に掛ける。100 で素の表のまま
note.en: Multiplies base cost × grade × settlement size. 100 keeps the table as is

note.ja: 1日あたりの売上に掛ける。100 で素の表のまま
note.en: Multiplies the daily takings. 100 keeps the table as is

label.ja: 売上を溜めておける日数
label.en: Days of takings the keeper holds

note.ja: この日数ぶんで頭打ち。長く放置すると、それ以上は溜まらない
note.en: Takings stop accumulating past this many days until you collect

note.ja: llm はゲームと同じ生成AIに建てるとき1回だけ聞く（数秒待つ）。table は用意した12人から選ぶ
note.en: llm asks the game's own generator once, when you build (a few seconds). table picks from 12 ready-made keepers

note.ja: 自分の宿屋の「無料で泊まる」で使う部屋。ゲームの宿屋の部屋と同じ語彙。ゲームの「宿泊する」は宿代を取る
note.en: The room used by "stay for free" at your own inn (the game's room names). The game's own "stay" still charges
